title: Chip assignment
description: Packet pickup: scan or type the bib, then read the chip with a desktop RFID reader. Each assignment is saved immediately and recorded in the audit log.
tagHelp: Click here and read the chip. Most desktop readers type the number and press Enter.
notFound: No participant with bib {{bib}} in this race.
inUse: That chip is already assigned to another participant in this race.
failed: The chip could not be assigned.
locked: Results are certified, so chips can no longer be changed.
